name: Mitsubishi Estate Logistics REIT Investment Corporation
summary: Mitsubishi Estate Logistics REIT Investment Corporation under the (Act on Investment Trust and Investment Corporation) (Investment Trust Law). It was listed on the REIT Securities Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange on September 14, 2017. MEL focuses on investing in logistics facilities as a listed real estate investment corporation. Mitsubishi Estate Co., Ltd. (MEC), one of the largest comprehensive developers in Japan, has been acting as a sponsor. MEL's asset management company, Mitsubishi Jisho Investment Advisors, Inc. has an extensive track record in real estate fund management since its establishment in 2001.
